from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 1.0 + j * 1.1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1.0
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout
        title = "Bayes' Theorem & Geometry of Belief"
        lecture_lines = [
            "- Prior: Initial belief P(H)",
            "- Evidence: New data observed",
            "- Likelihood: P(E|H)",
            "- Posterior: Updated belief P(H|E)",
            "- Geometry: Overlap of areas"
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)

        # 2. Bayes Formula
        formula = MathTex(
            "P(H|E) = \\frac{P(E|H)P(H)}{P(E)}",
            color=YELLOW
        )
        self.place_at_grid(formula, "A3", scale_factor=0.9)
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # 3. Geometric Representation (Unit Square)
        square = Square(side_length=3, stroke_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(square, "D3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Prior area (P(H))
        prior_rect = Rectangle(width=1.5, height=3, fill_color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_width=1)
        prior_rect.move_to(square.get_left(), aligned_edge=LEFT)
        prior_label = Text("P(H)", font_size=16).next_to(prior_rect, UP, buff=0.1)

        # Likelihood area (P(E|H) portion of H)
        likelihood_rect = Rectangle(width=1.5, height=1.2, fill_color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_width=1)
        likelihood_rect.move_to(prior_rect.get_bottom(), aligned_edge=BOTTOM)
        likelihood_label = Text("P(E|H)", font_size=14, color=GREEN).move_to(likelihood_rect)

        # Evidence (P(E)) - horizontal slice across the square
        evidence_line = Line(square.get_left(), square.get_right(), color=RED).shift(UP * 0.5)
        evidence_label = Text("Evidence Boundary", font_size=14, color=RED).next_to(evidence_line, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        # 4. Animations
        self.play(Create(square))
        self.play(FadeIn(prior_rect), Write(prior_label))
        self.wait(1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(likelihood_rect))
        self.play(Write(likelihood_label))
        self.wait(1)

        self.play(Create(evidence_line), Write(evidence_label))
        
        # Highlight Posterior
        posterior_box = SurroundingRectangle(likelihood_rect, color=YELLOW, buff=0.05)
        self.play(Create(posterior_box))
        
        post_text = Text("Posterior Focus", font_size=18, color=YELLOW)
        self.place_at_grid(post_text, "F3", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Write(post_text))
        
        self.wait(3)
